description: Central denylist consumed by src/shared/observability/redactor.ts (implementation-blueprint.md #14.1, threat-model.md redactor central gap). Field names are matched case-insensitively against object keys at any nesting depth.

redactedValuePatterns.name: bearerToken
redactedValuePatterns.description: Authorization header values that leak into free-text fields (e.g. sanitized SDK error messages).

redactedValuePatterns.name: email
redactedValuePatterns.description: Catches emails embedded in unstructured strings, e.g. provider SDK exception messages.

redactedValuePatterns.name: inlineKeyValueSecret
redactedValuePatterns.description: Catches key=value / key: value secrets embedded in free-text exception messages (e.g. "token=abc123 rejected").
